content.value: As shown in figure below, a homogeneous 50-kg rigid block is suspended by the three springs whose lower ends were originally at the same level. Each steel spring has 24 turns of 10 mm diameter wire on a mean diameter of 100 mm, and G = 8 GPa. The bronze spring has 48 turns of 20 mm diameter wire on a mean diameter of 150 mm, and G = 42 GPa. Compute the maximum shearing stress in each spring.
